notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded asynchronous-delivery services to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The same case now crosses the external IEEE Java API JAR through JNI and JPype, preserving the official callback metadata and source RegionHandle set. Evoked and immediate connection-loss DELETE_OBJECTS collisions release receive-order cleanup after a cutoff reflection and grant. It is not catalog evidence, a JUnit result, protected-review evidence, a production package claim, or a conformance claim.
